title: .LLab Creator Website Blueprint™
intro: Plan your creator website one phase at a time, so it is built to keep working and to be carried forward.

nodes.prompt: What is the one sentence your website must say about you and your work?
Who is the one person the site is for first, and what do they need from you?
What is the one action you want a visitor to take?
Which pages will the site have, and what does each one do for the visitor?
Which tool will you use for each step of the Streamlined Loop™: brief, build, hold, publish and connect?
What will you offer or sell on it, and how will people pay or contact you?
What is your update loop: how often will you update the site, and what is the first ten-minute update you will do?
Which photographs, copy and links will you keep current, and where do you keep them?
Who owns your domain, hosting account and code repository, and where are those logins safely kept?
If you could not touch the site for six months, what would keep it running and who could update it?
What will you write down so someone else could rebuild the site from your notes?

closing.prompt: The one change we will make next, who will own it, and by when:
